workdays.note: Not verified whether deadlines here move off weekends and holidays. Kyros shows the last working day on or before the legal date, so paying on it is always in time, and keeps the reserve locked until the next working day after it.

presets.label: Below BHD 37,500 a year: no VAT, no income tax

notes: Bahrain has no personal income tax. Corporate income tax applies to oil and gas companies, and a 15% domestic minimum top-up tax to large multinational groups only.
VAT registration is mandatory above BHD 37,500 of taxable supplies a year and voluntary from BHD 18,750.

A draft corporate income tax law (10% on local businesses) was sent to the legislature on 29 December 2025 and went to consultation in February 2026; it is not law, and its scope for individuals and small businesses is not public yet. The pack changes when it is enacted.
Rule packs are information, not tax advice. The user confirms the percentages; the vault enforces what the user chose.
